summary: go-zero's only performance result is a README 'Benchmark' section that embeds a remotely hosted chart and links a third-party benchmark repo (smallnest/go-web-framework-benchmark); no numbers, data, or harness for it are in the clone. It has 57 Go micro-benchmarks with no committed results, plus a marketing claim of serving 'tens of millions of users', so nothing quantitative is reproducible from the repo alone.
result_focus_note: manual classification of published_results: outcome = does the tool do its job; engineering = speed of the software itself
